item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Khamenei actively prioritized vulnerable groups as a governing principle. The best positive signals were late clemency, a temporary hijab-law pause, and some indirect technocratic staffing, all of which are weaker than the repeated evidence of targeted repression, discriminatory enforcement, and impunity.","evidence":[{"title":"Iran’s authorities waged a draconian campaign to enforce compulsory veiling laws through surveillance and mass car confiscations","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/","summary":"Amnesty says authorities used surveillance, police checks, confiscations, prosecutions, flogging, prison terms, and coercive “morality” classes against women. That is strong evidence of active harm to women and girls, not prioritization.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.1","5B.8"]},{"title":"Iran: New compulsory veiling law intensifies oppression of women and girls","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-12-10","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/","summary":"The law expanded enforcement powers for police, intelligence, IRGC, and Basij and imposed harsher punishments; Amnesty notes it hits economically disadvantaged women and girls especially hard. This is strong evidence against prioritizing vulnerable groups.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.1","5B.8","6B.2"]},{"title":"Iranian authorities’ crime of persecution against Baha’is in Iran","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://www.hrw.org/report/2024/04/01/boot-my-neck/iranian-authorities-crime-persecution-against-bahais-iran","summary":"HRW says authorities used national-security pretexts to raid, arrest, and prosecute Baha’is based on faith identity. That is direct evidence of failure to prioritize a persecuted minority.","question_ids":["6B.3","5B.8","6B.1"]},{"title":"Iran: Chokehold on Dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/iran-chokehold-dissent","summary":"HRW reports killings, mass arrests, torture, retaliation against critics, and continued repression of ethnic and religious minorities, including Baha’is, Sunnis, and non-Persian minorities. This is strong evidence against prioritization of marginalized communities.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.1","5B.8"]},{"title":"Amnesty says no effective investigations into security-force crimes two years after the uprising","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-11","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/","summary":"Amnesty says there were no effective investigations into killings, torture, sexual violence, or disappearances, and families faced harassment and arbitrary detention. That undercuts any claim of special concern for vulnerable groups.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.1"]},{"title":"Executions of a protester with a mental disability and a Kurdish Sunni man","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-01-24","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/01/iran-executions-of-protester-with-mental-disability-and-kurdish-man-mark-plunge-into-new-realms-of-cruelty/","summary":"Amnesty reports secretive, grossly unfair executions of a person with a mental disability and a Kurdish Sunni man. This is direct evidence against prioritizing disabled people and minorities.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.1"]},{"title":"Iran executes 853 people in eight-year high amid relentless repression and renewed war on drugs","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-04-04","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/04/iran-executes-853-people-in-eight-year-high-amid-relentless-repression-and-renewed-war-on-drugs/","summary":"Amnesty says the death-penalty surge included unfair Revolutionary Court trials and drug-offense executions. That is negative evidence for children, the poor, and other vulnerable defendants who are least protected by the system.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.1"]},{"title":"Iran: General situation","publisher":"EUAA","date":"2025-01","url":"https://www.euaa.europa.eu/country-guidance-iran-2025/641-general-situation","summary":"This January 2025 source summarizing conditions as of September 2024 says primary healthcare was generally free and urban water/sanitation had improved somewhat, but also that food security was threatened, around 30 percent lived below the poverty line, housing was unaffordable for many, and informal settlements had poor sanitary conditions and irregular access to water/heating. Mixed background evidence, but not a clear sign of prioritization.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"Khamenei approves pardons or commutations for thousands of inmates","publisher":"Press TV","date":"2024-09-20","url":"https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2024/09/20/733636/Leader-approves-pardoning-convicts","summary":"Khamenei approved pardons or commutations for 2,887 convicts, including some security-related cases and minors. This is the main positive item I found, but it is discretionary clemency, not durable prioritization of vulnerable groups.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.1"]},{"title":"Senior bodies paused implementation of the stricter hijab law for the time being","publisher":"Euronews / AP","date":"2024-12-18","url":"https://www.euronews.com/2024/12/18/iran-pauses-implementation-of-stricter-hijab-law-for-women","summary":"The pause is the clearest limited positive signal I found for women, but it was temporary and procedural. It does not show sustained prioritization of women or other marginalized groups.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.1","6B.2"]}]}
